claim_verdicts.evidence: refs ingress.md L25-33: "The Kubernetes project recommends using Gateway instead of Ingress. The Ingress API has been frozen. ... The Ingress API is generally available ... The Kubernetes project has no plans to remove Ingress from Kubernetes. The Ingress API is no longer being developed, and will have no further changes or updates made to it."

refs gateway.md: "Gateway API is an add-on containing API kinds ..."; "Gateway API is the successor to the Ingress API."; "Instead of Gateway API resources being natively implemented by Kubernetes, the specifications are defined as Custom Resources ... Install the Gateway API CRDs or follow the installation instructions of your selected implementation."

Round 2: claim and S4 now say only that Traefik's install guide has the reader apply the kinds as a separate step. Traefik getting-started (Kubernetes): "Install the Gateway API CRDs in your cluster:" followed by kubectl apply of standard-install, before installing Traefik. Script: traefik-install.sh L12-17 applies standard-install.yaml --server-side before the Application; traefik-install.txt L1-13 lists gatewayclasses/gateways/httproutes...; bundle-version v1.6.2.

Traefik v3.7 Kubernetes Gateway provider page: Helm values `providers: kubernetesGateway: enabled: true`. Traefik getting-started: with the Gateway provider enabled the chart "automatically creates a default GatewayClass named traefik". Routing page GatewayClass example uses controllerName `traefik.io/gateway-controller`. Execution: traefik-install.txt L26-30 shows ingressclass traefik and gatewayclass traefik, traefik.io/gateway-controller, ACCEPTED True; no GatewayClass manifest exists in the repo.

refs gateway.md: "A Gateway object is associated with exactly one GatewayClass; the GatewayClass describes the gateway controller responsible for managing Gateways of this class." and "A Gateway must reference a GatewayClass that contains the name of the controller that implements the class."

Gateway API v1.6 spec, Listener.hostname: "Hostname specifies the virtual hostname to match for protocol types that define this concept. When unspecified, all hostnames are matched." API overview: "Listeners describe how the Gateway should listen for traffic, and have a port, a protocol".

v1.6 spec, ParentReference.sectionName: "SectionName is the name of a section within the target resource. In the following resources, SectionName is interpreted as the following: Gateway: Listener name. ... When unspecified (empty string), this will reference the entire resource."

Round 2: claim and S4 now state a role model ("can write HTTPRoutes ... without editing"). refs gateway.md: "Cluster Operator: Manages clusters and is typically concerned with policies, network access, application permissions"; "Application Developer: ... concerned with application-level configuration and Service composition." API overview: Chihiro "the Cluster Admin and Gateway owner"; route exposure "in the hands of Ana, the Application Developer".

v1.6 spec: HTTPRouteSpec.hostnames "defines a set of hostnames that should match against the HTTP Host header"; HTTPRouteRule.matches "Each match is independent, i.e. this rule will be matched if any one of the matches is satisfied."; PathPrefix "Matches based on a URL path prefix split by `/`. Matching is case-sensitive and done on a path element by element basis."

tools/extract-code gateway.yaml --tag stage-3 L1-16: Gateway donhang, namespace donhang, gatewayClassName traefik (L12), listener http port 8000 protocol HTTP (L13-16); comment L3-5 states 8000/8443 and localhost:18080/18443. Block matches character for character.

gateway.sh L18: sed '/# lesson: k8s.l2.tls-at-the-gateway/,$d' cuts gateway.yaml before the https listener and redirect; L20: routes_without_refunds ... | sed 's/sectionName: https/sectionName: http/'.

extract-code httproutes.yaml --tag stage-3: L5-29 HTTPRoute api, parentRefs donhang/sectionName https, hostnames donhang.localhost, PathPrefix /api/v1 /api/v2 /openapi, backendRefs api:8080; L30-39 refunds rule (payments:8080); L42-56 HTTPRoute keycloak, auth.donhang.localhost, backendRefs keycloak:8080. Block matches.

edge-staging.yaml@stage-3: source path platform/edge, destination namespace donhang, syncPolicy automated (selfHeal, prune). gateway.sh L22-31 copies it, commits, then kubectl apply and waits Synced Healthy.

Gateway API Troubleshooting and Status: Programmed "True when an object's config has been fully parsed, and has been successfully sent to a data plane for configuration." Accepted "True when the object is semantically and syntactically valid" (and accepted by a controller). ResolvedRefs "True when all references to other objects inside an object are valid." Output gateway.txt L6-15: PROGRAMMED True, Accepted=True, ResolvedRefs=True.

outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/gateway.txt L17-21: /api/v1/products -> 200, /api/v2/orders/1 -> 401, /openapi/v1.json -> 200, Keycloak discovery -> 200, /index.html -> 404. No route in the committed httproutes.yaml matches /index.html on donhang.localhost, so the 404 cannot come from the api.

refs gateway.md: "Expressive: Gateway API kinds support functionality for common traffic routing use cases such as header-based matching, traffic weighting, and others that were only possible in Ingress by using custom annotations." v1.6 spec BackendRef weight: "Weight specifies the proportion of requests forwarded to the referenced backend."

refs deprecation-guide.md L392: "Use client warnings, metrics, and audit information available in 1.19+ to locate use of deprecated APIs." Execution: outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/ingress.txt L8-9 prints only `ingress.networking.k8s.io/api created`; scripts/capture-output.sh L43 captures with `2>&1`, so a stderr warning would have appeared.

Gateway API Troubleshooting and Status: a Route with an invalid parentRef gets no status update at all; an implementation only updates status for objects it can trace to a GatewayClass it owns, so no error appears on the Route. v1.6 spec RouteStatus.parents: "parent references that cannot be resolved by an implementation of this API will not be added to this list." Hence no Accepted=True.
outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/traefik-install.txt L20-21: only deployment.apps/traefik in namespace traefik; L29-30: gatewayclass traefik, CONTROLLER traefik.io/gateway-controller, ACCEPTED True.

Traefik routing, Gateway API: "Please note that `Gateway` listener ports must match the configured EntryPoint ports of the Traefik deployment." "In case they do not match, an `ERROR` message is logged, and the resource status is updated accordingly." No doc page seen names 8000; execution settles it: gateway.txt L6-7 Gateway donhang (listener 8000) PROGRAMMED True, L17 /api/v1/products via 18080 -> 200. Round 2 opened: Traefik routing/gateway-api, getting-started, kubernetes-gateway provider pages; repo traefik.yaml, gateway.txt.
